decision: D-002: Any change to the OVPR requirements or architecture is reviewed by polfer before it is made. No edit to docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/, no override of a polfer decision, and no code that departs from the written design until polfer approves the exact change. Each change is a proposal (RC-nn) quoting the current text; its docs PR merges before dependent code. D-001 approves no requirements text.

governingRule.description: polfer instruction 2026-11-16 (OVPR fix plan, DECISIONS.md (directive-ovpr-planning-202611) D-002; OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md)

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: A PR is not where a requirements change gets proposed

whyWinner: polfer required review before the change, not after.
